title: fix(settings)!: the Knowledge settings page keeps only keys something reads (adapter, over_fetch, enforce_rls retired)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3zXREECfPtgrM8TPQaxn1v)_

Fixes #37104

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowed: `PUT /api/settings/knowledge` refuses `adapter`, `over_fetch` and `enforce_rls` (`400 UNKNOWN_KEY`), where it stored them; `GET /api/settings/knowledge` no longer serves them; `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` no longer answers from `adapter` (a stored or sent `ragflow` was "Unknown adapter", `memory` an in-memory warning) and answers every call from `turso_url` and `turso_auth_token` alone
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches the three retired keys; `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` teaches `knowledge.chunk_target`, which stays. `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` says what the page holds.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员打开「知识库」设置页，不再看到「适配器」下拉、「过取倍数」和「搜索时强制行级权限」开关及两条警告；页面只剩 Turso 连接两项和目标片段大小，并写明 Turso 两项只在平台数据库不是 PostgreSQL 时才被读取。
- 为什么做：属于知识库平台边界整理第二阶段；这几项在开源版里没有任何代码读取，页面写的适配器与实际挂载的存储无关，权限开关关掉也不生效、却看起来能关掉安全检查。
- 出错会怎样：以前保存过这些值的环境照常打开页面，旧值保留在库里但不再显示、不再被读取；有脚本写这三项会被拒收；撤回这次合并即可恢复原页面。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Each key on the Knowledge page was measured for a reader on `origin/main` at `90f7555e4` before deciding (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: a setting nothing reads is not offered).

| Key | Reader on main | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `adapter` | none but "Test connection" itself (`knowledgeTestActionHandler`, `merged.adapter`) | **removed**, with its `Backend` group and the "Existing indices are not migrated" banner |
| `turso_url` | `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/src/plugin.ts:367` (`saved('turso_url')` → `settings.get('knowledge', key)` at :356), at `kernel:bootstrapped` | kept |
| `turso_auth_token` | `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/src/plugin.ts:368` | kept |
| `chunk_target` | `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service-plugin.ts:474` (`settings.get('knowledge', 'chunk_target')`), the splitter's channel | kept |
| `over_fetch` | none (`git grep -n over_fetch -- packages` outside the manifest, its locale strings and its test: 0 hits; search refills from the constants `SEARCH_FIRST_ROUND_FACTOR = 5` / `SEARCH_REFILL_FACTOR = 20`, `knowledge-service.ts:2478,2486`) | **removed** |
| `enforce_rls` | none (same grep: 0 hits; `applyPermissionFilter`, `knowledge-service.ts:2188`, re-checks every hit as the caller with no setting read) | **removed**, with the "Leave RLS on in production" banner and the `Permissions` group |

`chunk_overlap` (#37098) and the ragflow option and keys (#37004) were already gone; confirmed absent.

**`adapter`: removed rather than shown read-only, because removal is the smaller honest option.** The settings spec has no specifier that renders a runtime value: `title_value` is keyless and the Console draws its stored value (`SettingsField.tsx`: `String(value ?? '—')`), so a "mounted store" display would need a new specifier capability (a spec contract change) or a stored value that something writes and nothing reads, the same defect again. The page also cannot know the answer per source at manifest time: a source's store is the one its own `adapter` names, among those mounted (`requires: ['knowledge']` mounts one, chosen by the platform database in `resolveKnowledgeStore`, `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts`). That answer already exists per source: the `index_status` action reports each source's `adapter`, and `os knowledge status` prints it (`packages/cli/src/commands/knowledge/status.ts:58`).

- **Manifest** (`knowledge.manifest.ts`): `adapter`, `over_fetch`, `enforce_rls` and both `info_banner` rows leave; `version` 3 → 4 (the spec's "increment when keys are renamed/removed"). The Turso group and its two keys lose their `${data.adapter === 'turso'}` predicates and always show; the group's description now says they are read only when the platform database is not PostgreSQL, and not read on PostgreSQL. The file header names every remaining key's reader.
- **"Test connection"** (`knowledgeTestActionHandler`): reads `turso_url` and `turso_auth_token` only. The `memory` branch and the "Unknown adapter" branch go; a stale `adapter` in the values or the payload changes nothing. Still a form check that opens no connection, and says so on every answer.
- **Locales**: the strings for the three keys, the `adapter` and `permissions` groups and both banners leave all eleven bundles; the Turso group description gains the "read only when not PostgreSQL" sentence in each.
- **Docs**: one bullet in `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` saying what Settings → Knowledge holds and that no setting turns the per-user re-check off.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/service-settings` patch (the only package whose code changes), BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**What an environment with a stored `enforce_rls = false` sees**: the `sys_platform_setting` row stays (the settings service never deletes a stored row). The page loads with no RLS toggle and no banner, `GET` does not serve the value, and nothing reads it, exactly as nothing read it before: every search has always re-checked each hit as the asking user. A write of `enforce_rls` is refused `400 UNKNOWN_KEY`. The same holds for stored `adapter` (including `ragflow`) and `over_fetch`; "Test connection" no longer answers a stored `ragflow` as "Unknown adapter", because it no longer reads `adapter` at all.

The `spec-property-retirement` skill does not apply: these are settings-manifest keys (a runtime registration), not `packages/spec` properties, so there is no tombstone, conversion or authorable-surface baseline.

## Tests

- New `packages/services/service-settings/src/knowledge-settings-retired-keys.pin.test.ts`: through the real settings routes over the real `ObjectQL` engine, with stored rows for `adapter = ragflow`, `over_fetch`, `enforce_rls = false`, `chunk_overlap` and the three ragflow keys (an encrypted one with a dangling `sec_` handle) beside saved `chunk_target` and `turso_url`: `GET /api/settings/knowledge` answers 200 with exactly the three declared keys, saved values served; a stored `enforce_rls = false` appears nowhere; "Test connection" answers 200 from the stored `turso_url`, never "Unknown adapter"; saving `chunk_target` works and leaves the retired rows stored; a write of each retired key is `400 UNKNOWN_KEY` and changes nothing.
- `knowledge.manifest.test.ts`: version 4, the exact key list `turso_url, turso_auth_token, chunk_target`, groups `turso, indexing`, no `visible` predicate and no `data.adapter` anywhere, no `info_banner`; the handler tests rewritten without `adapter`, plus "a stale adapter in the values or the payload changes nothing".
- `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts`: the corpus predicate tripwire 83 → 79 (the Turso group, its two keys and `over_fetch`).
- `__tests__/settings-door.testkit.ts`: `bootSettingsDoor` also returns `request(route, params, body)` for any registered route.
- No file in `packages/services/service-knowledge/` changed; its `knowledge-settings-contribution.test.ts` (which posts `{ adapter: 'turso', turso_url }` to the test door) passes unchanged.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: Test Files 78 passed (78), Tests 1524 passed (1524); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck`: tsc clean. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge test` (after rebuilding its dependency closure): Test Files 15 passed (15), Tests 466 passed (466). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation (committed fix first): `enforce_rls` put back into the manifest on disk → the new pin file 3 failed / 2 passed (loads, enforce_rls, write refusal); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, 5 passed.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 96 families): 94 exit 0; `check:skill-examples` exit 3 until `@objectstack/client-react` was built, then exit 0; NOT MEASURED locally, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's dist). Both run in CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 96 derived, 94 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: the changeset reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, exit 0.
- `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean exit 0 against `origin/main`.
- Full dogfood battery: at 816c01e8a, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` after building its dependency closure: Test Files 488 passed, 3 skipped (491); Tests 4135 passed, 68 skipped (4203); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The Turso group's English fallback keeps its existing last sentence ("In a cloud deployment with a database per organization, leave blank to reuse that organization's own database connection"). In this repository an empty `turso_url` opens the store's own `knowledge.db`, never the platform database (the "Test connection" answer says so); the sentence describes a cloud composition this repository cannot measure, so it was left as found. carrier: cloud.
- The manifest's namespace description ("Vector-store backend for RAG / knowledge sources") is unchanged in all locales; the page still configures the libSQL backend's connection.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts` — the specifier list (three keys left, no predicates) and `knowledgeTestActionHandler`.
2. `packages/services/service-settings/src/knowledge-settings-retired-keys.pin.test.ts` — what an upgraded environment's stored rows do.
3. `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/zh-CN.ts` — one locale's knowledge block, representative of the eleven.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/knowledge-settings-retired-keys.pin.test.ts` — expect `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
